facts.interpretation: RCX module entry is saved; +0x10c DWORD is a skip discriminator, +0x30 QWORD is mapped image base; normal completed success writes WORD +0x6e=ffff. Field names beyond these offsets are not inferred from PDB public function names.
ActiveThreadCount==0, entry+10c==9, or NULL TLS directory each returns zero without slot construction.
N is loaded as DWORD; N==1 uses 40-byte SP+c8 descriptor, otherwise heap allocation 16+24*N. The allocation uses 64-bit size; syscall length is separately DWORD.
Descriptor +0 DWORD 0, +4 DWORD expanded mode, +8 DWORD N, +c DWORD old capacity (mode1) or new index (mode0).
Records start descriptor+0x10, stride0x18: +0 DWORD flags, +8 QWORD inout pointer, +10 QWORD kernel-returned token. No meaning assigned to unobserved padding.

rawBytes=EndRaw-StartRaw; alignment=max(16, code==0?1:1<<(code-1)). Allocate rawBytes+alignment, aligned=(base+alignment)&~(alignment-1), aligned[-8]=base. Allocation arithmetic is native wraparound; no universal malformed-size safety theorem.
Original UNWIND scope reaches 5c179 on handled exception. 22 recovery instructions are EH-reachable, not dead code. Negative status frees current raw allocation.
Submit process TLS-update class0x23 to current process pseudo-handle -1. Request length is 32-bit; globals/syscall outputs remain runtime unknown.

Reverse cleanup: mask0x2 => free raw data(mode0) or defer vector(mode1) when pointer!=NULL; else mask0x1=>PotentialTlsLeaks++; else localCount++, free new vector if mode1 then new raw data. No undocumented flag names/ownership theorem imposed.
Only nonnegative saved status subtracts local cleanup count from ActiveThreadCount and writes entry+6e=ffff. Actual entry+6e write is gated by the final signed test.
Negative status: unlink found module record, check links (INT29 code3 if corrupt), clear index bit; if expanded, reduce bitmap logical size by8. No visible restoration of PE *AddressOfIndex.
Ordinary return = saved negative NTSTATUS or zero, after cookie validation.
Allocate72 bytes; copy40-byte PE TLS directory to record+10 under SEH; EndRaw<StartRaw => C000007B.
Actual main supplies non-NULL expanded pointer, so acquire bitmap slot. Write DWORD chosen slot through TLS.AddressOfIndex under second SEH scope.
Record+40 DWORD index, +38 QWORD module entry; insert in LdrpTlsList with backlink check/fastfail; optional output pointer gets record.

On protected AddressOfIndex write failure in normal non-NULL-expanded ABI, clear acquired bit, shrink logical capacity if it expanded, free record. Earlier copy/slot failures free record. No claim of restoring a partially modified external index.
Find first clear logical bit by NOT/BSF with alignment adjustment; RtlSetBits(bitmap,index,1), *index=index,*expanded=0.

Grow logical capacity by8 (DWORD arithmetic), clear7 following bits and set old-capacity bit; *expanded=1. LdrpActualBitmapSize is QWORD storage count. First allocation uses inline static vector; larger buffers may allocate/copy/free. Assumes normal coherent bitmap state, not arbitrary corrupt sizes.
Allocate16+8*slotCount; header first DWORD=count, zero entire pointer array only, return header+16, then main writes newSlot=alignedTLSData. Other12 header bytes not proven initialized.
Header=data-16; bucket=(token>>2)&15; put token at header+0 and next at header+8 under bucket SRW lock; table has16 buckets of16 bytes. No immediate free here.

Normally filter returns1 after logging. DebugFlags&30==20 enables prompt: I/i execute handler; B/b,O/o debug INT3; P/p terminate current process; T/t terminate current thread, with exception code. No real PEB/TEB read by analysis.

template_return_consumption.meaning: After CALLR14(moduleEntry), no status TEST/CMP/Jcc/store occurs before LeaveCriticalSection CALL+0xd3 and EAX overwrite+0xd6. Later callback/entry sequence continues if calls return. Exceptions/termination need not return.

remaining_boundaries: Kernel implementation of NtSetInformationProcess class0x23 and exact undocumented record flag names/token type are outside this offline user-mode slice. Caller reads are complete; returned memory is modeled as INOUT.
Public heap/copy/memset/SRW/bitmap routines are semantic cut points; no arbitrary corrupted-pointer, allocator, or kernel proof is asserted.
RtlSetBits/RtlClearBits exact public starts have split .pdata fragments; their tiny first fragments are not claimed as full native function coverage.

Raw TLS allocation uses EndRaw-StartRaw and has no explicit SizeOfZeroFill(+TLSdir0x20 / record0x30) add/zero operation in this slice. Do not infer universal full PE TLS conformance or a defect without surrounding loader contract.
Runtime coherent bitmap/thread state and valid mapped-image/LDR input are normal ABI conditions. Huge UINT32 counts, wraparound TLS sizes and corrupted pointers are not proven safe.
Other consumers which eventually reclaim the deferred table and full logging/debugger/termination implementations are outside this necessary-callee scope.
This installed ntdll build is version/hash pinned. Selection and behavior are not generalized to all target-machine ntdll versions and do not prove that the malware ran successfully.
